description: This file contains classes and functions for handling input streams, character encoding detection, and parsing HTML meta tags related to encoding, used in the html5lib project.

classes.name: BufferedStream
classes.description: A buffering wrapper for streams that do not have their own buffering, allowing reading and seeking.

classes.name: HTMLUnicodeInputStream
classes.description: Provides a unicode character stream from various sources, handling encoding detection and line/column tracking.

classes.name: HTMLBinaryInputStream
classes.description: Extends HTMLUnicodeInputStream to handle binary streams, including encoding detection via BOM, meta tags, and chardet.

classes.name: EncodingBytes
classes.description: A string-like object with position tracking, used for parsing encoding declarations.

classes.name: EncodingParser
classes.description: Mini parser to detect character encoding from HTML meta tags.

methods.name: HTMLInputStream
methods.description: Factory function that returns either a Unicode or binary input stream based on source type.

methods.name: HTMLUnicodeInputStream
methods.description: Initializes a unicode stream, handling encoding detection and line/column tracking.

methods.name: HTMLBinaryInputStream
methods.description: Initializes a binary stream, detects encoding via BOM, meta tags, or chardet, and converts to unicode.

methods.name: EncodingBytes
methods.description: String-like class with position tracking for encoding detection.

methods.name: EncodingParser
methods.description: Parses HTML meta tags to extract encoding information.

methods.name: codecName
methods.description: Converts encoding labels to Python codec names if valid.
